name: Galaxy Peek Series 2
sourced: 25 figures, cross-checked against the Disney Doorables community wiki, HobbyDB and Coleka. Just Play has not published an official checklist online, and their own pages for Series 1 and 2 now 404 — so treat this as very good community data rather than gospel.
numberNote: The number printed beside each figure on the paper checklist inside the capsule.
codeNote: Every capsule has a short code pressed into the plastic on the BOTTOM — a letter and two numbers, like P02. It is moulded rather than printed, so tilt it to the light or feel for it with a fingernail. Collectors work out which code means which figure, but the codes change between batches and Just Play has never published them. So this app does not guess: write down the code you find when you open one, and it becomes your own key.
codeLinkLabel: Community code spreadsheet (via the Doorables wiki)
